title: Self Assessment Spreadsheet UK 2025/26, Sole Trader Tax Return Calculator, Payments on Account Planner, SA103 Boxes, Excel Google Sheets
description:
Your 2025/26 Self Assessment, worked out before 31 January 2027. Type in what you were paid and what you spent. The kit sorts every cost into HMRC's categories, puts each total next to its SA103 box number, and shows your Income Tax, Class 4 National Insurance and exactly what to pay on 31 January and 31 July.

See more of our Self-Employed Finance tools here: https://www.etsy.com/shop/WayofWealthStudio?section_id=57077419
See the rest of our shop here: https://www.etsy.com/shop/WayofWealthStudio
Track costs all year with our best seller, the Self Employed Expense Tracker: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4475265519
Want the full set? Our Self Employed Tax Toolkit Bundle: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4517461053

WHAT'S INSIDE (11 TABS)
- Dashboard: total to pay by 31 Jan, tax, profit, days left, 5 charts and your next 3 steps
- Start Here, Settings, Income Log, Expenses Log, Mileage (HMRC flat rates), Use of Home (flat rate)
- SA103 Boxes: every figure next to its box on the short and full forms, checked against HMRC's 2025/26 forms
- Tax Estimate (2025/26 rates, Scottish bands too), 2026/27 Tax Pot, Deadlines checklist

WHY IT'S EASY
- One example file (filled in) and one blank file, clearly named
- Plain step-by-step Start Here tab for first-time filers
- Works in Excel 2016+ and Google Sheets (use the tab bar in Sheets)

UK only: made for UK sole traders filing with HMRC. Not tax advice and it does not file your return; HMRC's calculation is final. Questions: joel@wayofwealthcoaching.com

Digital download: nothing is posted. The photo scenes were made with AI; the spreadsheet on every screen and in the video is the real product.
